race.description: Road To Magic Millions Book Now Plate (C3)
race.comment: STRADA VARENNA (11) is in career-best touch and hard to look past after justifying her short quote at the latest. Gets in a treat at the weights with Newman's 3kg claim and can continue on her merry way. ARTISTIC VENTURE (15) resumes from G3 company and her trials suggest she's come back in good order. Tackles her easiest assignment in quite some time but would prefer a fraction further. DESANTO (13) is a progressive mare that gets the chance to see where she's at second-up after a neat win at the Sunny Coast. Stable is on fire, she deserves respect. Similarly, CARDONETTE (9) is on her way through the grades, though will need a clever ride from BT out there. Watch for her launching late.
